calls.label: Probability
calls.subject: A compact branching chance mechanism: a single upper feed chute divides into two substantial Y-shaped grooved channels, then into four open terminal cups, forming a sculptural branching silhouette. Small ivory balls are held at different forks; one small red ball rests at the first decision fork. Mechanical dividers and channel lips are clearly drawn. The physical forks, empty gaps and four outcomes are the visual idea; avoid a generic node-link graph and avoid dice, playing cards or percentages.

calls.label: Statistics
calls.subject: A sampled distribution apparatus: an open shallow collector tray holds a row of seven close-set upright chambers filled with ivory beads to visibly different heights, forming an asymmetric rounded mound silhouette. A slender sampling scoop lifts one red bead just above the row at one side. The seven chambers and scoop form one compact object, viewed three-quarter-on. No branches, no pegboard, no chart axes or statistical labels. It suggests samples accumulating into a distribution without claiming actual data.

calls.label: Optimization
calls.subject: A hand-carved terrain specimen with one low hollow and two unequal rounded rises, as a compact irregular sculpted slab. Fine engraved contour-like grooves follow its surface. A narrow inset vermilion thread winds down from the higher ridge in a few deliberate bends and ends in the shallow hollow. The thread has no arrowhead. Let the changing elevation and descending path create the silhouette and focal point. No chart axes, no formula, no floating location pin, no claim of a computed optimum.

calls.label: Information Theory
calls.subject: One physical coded-channel motif: two small open comb-shaped encoder and receiver frames joined by a narrow taut ivory ribbon that passes through a constricted central channel. Alternating raised and recessed rectangular studs along the ribbon suggest an abstract code, with just one red stud. Small irregular graphite flecks are enclosed inside the channel, suggesting interference without becoming an exterior cloud. Keep this a crisp sparse bridge-like silhouette, with no letters, binary digits, actual cipher text, wave graph, or measured information claim.

calls.label: Control Theory
calls.subject: A compact feedback governor inspired by a centrifugal flyball mechanism: two ivory spherical weights on hinged graphite arms around a vertical spindle, a sliding collar, and one clearly returning mechanical linkage to a small valve at its base. The return linkage forms a readable open loop around the lower portion. One small red collar is the sole colour accent. Balance the two elevated weights with a narrow vertical shaft and modest base; do not fill the negative spaces with detail. No dial markings, labels, arrows or claim of a working regulator.

calls.label: Signal Processing
calls.subject: A wave-through-filter apparatus: a graphite-edged ivory wave ribbon enters from the left with tight ripples, passes through three spaced upright slotted filter plates at the centre, and emerges at the right as a smooth broad wave. All is one connected tactile miniature, with transparent gaps between plates. One thin red inner filter vane is the only accent. Prioritise the before-and-after wave silhouette, keep the overall composition compact and fully inside the margins. No axes, frequency labels, numerical readouts, glowing traces or literal circuit schematic.

calls.label: Numerical Methods
calls.subject: A stepped approximation of a smooth form: one ivory rising curved arch is accompanied closely by a staircase of six substantial graphite-edged blocks, their upper corners approaching the curve. Show both as a single compact sculptural teaching object in three-quarter view, with clean separation between the continuous curved band and the discrete steps. One small exposed step face is muted vermilion. The contrast of smooth and stepped geometry is the entire idea. No grids, axes, coordinates, equations, tick marks, labels or claims of numerical accuracy.

calls.label: Geometry
calls.subject: A constructed faceted solid and drawing compass: an open ivory polyhedral solid with a few visible triangular faces and substantial graphite edges, accompanied by a single elegant open drafting compass whose legs frame one lower corner. The solid and compass make one coherent compact still life, with generous clear holes through the constructed form. One tiny red compass hinge is the only colour accent. Refined proportions and crisp planar transitions; no secondary tools, baseline drawing, dimension marks, letters, numbers or claim of exact geometric construction.

calls.label: Topology
calls.subject: A single continuous knotted surface: a broad ivory ribbon forms a compact trefoil-like knot with three clear openings and readable over-under passages. The surface must appear continuous, substantial and untorn, with graphite hatching following its curvature and true empty holes. One short muted vermilion inlaid segment follows the ribbon surface. Emphasise connectedness and distinct occlusion rather than concentric atomic orbits. No disconnected loops, diagram labels, arrows, impossible intersecting sheets, glossy chrome, or claim of a verified topological model.

calls.label: Cryptography
calls.concept: Interlocking cipher wheel without literal secret text
calls.subject: An interlocking cipher-wheel mechanism: three offset concentric ivory discs with graphite engraved rims and physical teeth, with a smaller toothed wheel meshing into the outer rim. Alternating blank recessed slots and raised tabs suggest alignment without encoding any literal message. A single tiny muted red alignment tab is the accent. Show enough depth and clear gaps to read the interlock in a coherent three-quarter view. No letters, digits, tick labels, secret text, padlock, keyhole, currency mark, brand emblem, or claim of real encryption.
